days_detail: File no later than 10 days after the ad is disseminated or the solicitation is sent. Optional pre-approval is requested not fewer than 30 days before first dissemination. The rule states no review period.
text: Texas: lawyers must file their ads with a bar or court office, after the ad first runs. The standard fee is $100 per ad.
